response.value: Herb, shrubs receive more green light
steps: Herbs and shrubs typically grow under the canopy of larger trees, acting as shade plants.
The leaves of the canopy absorb most of the red and blue light for their own photosynthesis.
The light that filters through the canopy and reaches the herbs and shrubs is predominantly green and far-red light.
Green light is the least effective wavelength for photosynthesis.
Because they receive proportionally more green light and less red/blue light, their rate of photosynthesis is lower compared to sun plants.
